name: nowo-tech/form-kit-bundle
description: Symfony bundle to reduce repetitive form field options: convention-based labels/placeholder/help (form_snake.field_snake.*), configurable attr/row_attr/translation_domain, and cascading option merge (global → field type → form → field). Symfony 7.4|8.

suggest.a2lix/translation-form-bundle: For the optional "translations" type in FormTypeMap (^3.2 on PHP 8.2/Symfony 7.4, ^4.0 on PHP 8.4+/Symfony 7.4|8)
suggest.nowo-tech/select-all-choice-bundle: For addMultiSelectSelectAll() / addMultiSelectSelectAllType() ("Select all" on ChoiceType multiple)
suggest.symfony/ux-autocomplete: Entity autocomplete fields; use addAutocompleteField() / addAutocompleteFieldType() with your autocomplete FormType FQCN
suggest.symfony/ux-dropzone: For addDropzone() / addDropzoneField() / addDropzoneFieldType() (drag-and-drop file upload)
suggest.symfony/ux-cropperjs: For addCropper() / addCropperField() / addCropperFieldType() (image crop widget)
suggest.symfony/ux-live-component: Optional Live Component forms; see the demo /conditional-fields-live page and USAGE conditional-fields section
suggest.symfony/ux-icons: For help_modal.ux_icon (IconRendererInterface) instead of icon_html only

scripts-descriptions.test-coverage: Run PHPUnit tests with code coverage
